## Verification

- [ ] Extension changes pass `npm --prefix extensions/design-jarvis-pack run check`.

## Public-core checklist

- [ ] The change is useful across industries and organizations.
- [ ] It does not add a required private connector, proprietary repository, fixed vendor design system, employee identifier, credential, or private customer data.
- [ ] New guidance cites public sources or clearly identifies project-provided context.
- [ ] Shared starters remain read-only during project work.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are documented.
